text: サチと　くんだら　こわいもの　なしだぜ！

structure.en: when I team up with Kia

structure.jp: こわいもの　なしだぜ！

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens; after some verbs it sounds like だら. くんだら = 'when I team up'.

patterns.name: 〜なし
patterns.explanation: なし after a thing means 'without it' or 'there is none'. こわいもの　なし = 'nothing to be scared of'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, cocky, boyish way of stating something. なしだぜ = 'there's none, man!'
